packMeta.name: Job & Invoice Desk (SoftN + Forms)
packMeta.description: Turnkey job-to-quote-to-invoice-to-payment billing pipeline with client ledger, auto-numbered quotes & tax invoices, partial payment reconciliation, and overdue chase queue. Includes the full-stack SoftN application plus 5 schema-matched FormLogic forms & management charts sharing the same live SQLite database.
